text: 3平面波の非局所projectorと有限温度占有 A three-wave periodic projector and Fermi-occupation model 3平面波の非局所projectorと有限温度占有 H_{GG\prime}(k,R)=\tfrac12(G+k)^2\delta_{GG\prime}+V_{GG\prime}+\eta\beta_G\beta_{G\prime}^*,\quad\beta_G=e^{-(G+k)^2/(2\sigma^2)}e^{-i(G+k)R};\quad f_{kn}=\frac{2}{1+e^{(\varepsilon_{kn}-\mu)/T}},\quad\sum_{kn}w_kf_{kn}=1.5;\quad F=\sum_{kn}w_kf_{kn}\varepsilon_{kn}-TS,\quad F_R=-\sum_{kn}w_kf_{kn}\langle u_{kn}|\partial_RH_k|u_{kn}\rangle G=-1,0,1、k=±0.25、等重み、T=.05、電子数1.5の自作線形模型です。 無次元のG=-1,0,1、p=G+k、k=±.25、重み各.5、T=.05、平均電子数N=1.5、スピン係数2。実在格子定数や金属へ換算しません。 A three-wave periodic projector and Fermi-occupation model H_{GG\prime}(k,R)=\tfrac12(G+k)^2\delta_{GG\prime}+V_{GG\prime}+\eta\beta_G\beta_{G\prime}^*,\quad\beta_G=e^{-(G+k)^2/(2\sigma^2)}e^{-i(G+k)R};\quad f_{kn}=\frac{2}{1+e^{(\varepsilon_{kn}-\mu)/T}},\quad\sum_{kn}w_kf_{kn}=1.5;\quad F=\sum_{kn}w_kf_{kn}\varepsilon_{kn}-TS,\quad F_R=-\sum_{kn}w_kf_{kn}\langle u_{kn}|\partial_RH_k|u_{kn}\rangle Authored rank-one periodic linear model and finite-N Helmholtz forces. No real metal/element pseudopotential/norm conservation/Hartree-XC/long MD claim. N=1.5 is a mean independent-particle Fermi occupation count, not an integer-N canonical many-body ensemble. Dimensionless G=-1,0,1,p=G+k,k=±.25 with equal.5weights,T=.05,mean electron countN=1.5 and spin factor2.
